sentences.text:
Kuldeep Mishra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29
December, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:37901
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Himanshu Joshi

On The 29th Of December, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 60265 of 2025
 Kuldeep Mishra
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Garvit Singh - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rahul Solanki - Govt. Advocate for the responden

Order 
This third application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of temporary bail in connection with Crime No. 550/2025, registered at Police Station - Rajgarh District Rajgarh (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC and Section(s) 7A, 8, 11, 12(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act and Section(s) 66D and 72 of IT Act.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 20.8.2025.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the mother of applicant has met with an accident and she has been advised for knee replacement surgery.
The applicant is the only male member available at home and his presence is necessary.
His brother is in BSF, who is unable to take care of his ailing mother.
Therefore, applicant may be extended benefit of temporary bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the aforesaid prayer.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the aforesaid, this application for temporary bail is allowed and it is hereby directed that the applicant - Kuldeep Mishra s hall be released on temporary bail for a period of 30 days from the date of his release upon furnishing personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of same amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
He shall also comply with the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
The applicant shall surrender before the trial Court on or before expiry of period of 30 days.
Necessary papers regarding surrender of the applicant be furnished to this Court.

This temporary bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 stands disposed of.
